hC02 writer: magic (4B) + five RAM bytes + FUN_0800a890(buf,10) at +0x0A, writes 12 bytes to SRAM via FUN_080415a0. Only traced writer flushing live RAM values into a checksummed block.
Validates one 0x30 record at idx*0x30+_DAT_0804395c (base unrecovered); 2-byte magic, checksum at +0x2E, returns sign-derived mask of u16 at +2. Caller is a func_-alias call.
Same as 0x0804390c with base _DAT_080439b4 / magic _DAT_080439b8 (both unrecovered).
Wraps FUN_08043964 on buffer _DAT_08043ca0; additionally requires u16 at record+2 < 4. Callers are func_-alias calls.

fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: That region is zero-filled to its (unknown) length and its magic restamped; nothing else changes.
